name: Nigeria - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB)
publisher: OCHA, from the Office of the Surveyor General of the Federation (OSGOF), eHealth Africa and the UN Cartographic Section
notes: Dataset last modified 2026-04-16. Admin levels 0-3; level 3 (wards) is for operational purposes only. Bakassi (NG009005) has no population record.

name: geoBoundaries gbOpen NGA ADM1 and ADM2
notes: ADM1 has 37 units and ADM2 has 774 units.

name: INEC polling units statistics
notes: States 176,846 polling units, 8,809 registration areas and 774 LGAs across 36 states and the FCT.

name: INEC Polling Unit Directory, revised January 2015 (one PDF per state)
notes: Lists the LGAs, registration areas (wards) and polling units of each state.

name: Nigeria - INEC LGA and Wards
notes: From 2017; covers only some states. Used as a cross-check.

name: CBN lists of financial institutions
notes: Regulator's lists by category, including commercial, merchant, non-interest and microfinance banks, payment service banks and mobile money operators.

name: Revised Standards on Nigeria Uniform Bank Account Number (NUBAN) for Banks and Other Financial Institutions
publisher: Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN), Payments System Management Department
notes: Check-digit algorithm with weights 3,7,3 repeated; OFI codes are prefixed with 9.

name: NCC Mobile Number Allocation Table
notes: Allocations as at December 2023; page updated 2024-11-25. Mobile number portability means a prefix shows the original network, not always the current one.

name: NIPOST National Digital Alphanumeric Postcode System
notes: Launched 2026-10-01. 11-character codes such as FC02A09DB09 (State, LGA, District, Area, Building). Lookups go through a gated API, so only the format is described here.
